identity.description: Close is a sales CRM (close.com) with a public REST API at api.close.com and developer docs at developer.close.com. Sources consistently describe the same product.
identity.identity_notes: Developer docs at developer.close.com describe the Close sales CRM (leads, contacts, opportunities, activities) and API base https://api.close.com/api/v1. Matches the 'CRM and Sales' category and close.com hint.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code flow: authorize at https://app.close.com/oauth2/authorize/ with client_id and redirect_uri; exchange code by POST to https://api.close.com/oauth2/token/; grant_type refresh_token supported. Refresh tokens issued only when app requests offline_access scope; refresh rotates and old refresh token is revoked.
auth.token_refresh: Access token has limited lifetime (expires_in seconds). With offline_access, refresh_token is returned; server issues a new refresh token on each refresh and revokes the old one.
auth.scopes_notes: No granular OAuth scopes were established beyond offline_access. API keys carry an access level (Read only or Read, write, and delete) capped by the user's role.

access.production_restrictions: Public OAuth apps must be made public via 'Make Public and submit for review' and reviewed by Close; Integrations Directory listing requires emailing support@close.com with integration name, description, product link, use description, and OAuth Client ID. Integrations Directory requires OAuth 2.0 (not API keys) and public availability. Partners not using Close can request a free Dev organization by emailing support@close.com.

read_ops: Query last 30 days of changes to any object via Event Log
write_ops: Create/update leads, contacts, opportunities, activities, custom fields (write access level required)
api.rate_limits: Rate limits apply to all endpoints; handle 429 with exponential backoff. Specific numbers not established.
api.limitations: Specific rate limit values and full endpoint list not established. Webhooks are set up via subscriptions per developer docs ('Set up webhooks if you need real-time updates'). Breadth rated Broad based on resource list and read/write access levels; not fully enumerated.
